normalized_matching_profile.name: Southern Sol
normalized_matching_profile.description: 4 Bedroom Home with Private Pool Near Seagrove Beach | 30AWelcome to Southern Sol, a bright and spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath beach home nestled in the prestigious Watersound Beach community on Scenic 30A. Sleeping up to 12 guests, it’s perfect for families, friends, or multi-generational getaways. With an open-concept living space, private pool, and thoughtful touches throughout, Southern Sol is your home base for enjoying the beach, local dining, and the charm of 30A.Your SpaceThe open floor plan flows seamlessly between the oversized kitchen and the great room, creating a comfortable gathering space for your group. The living area connects naturally to the dining space, so whether you’re cooking, watching a movie on the large TV, or relaxing by the fire after a day at the beach, everyone stays part of the moment. The kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances, including a fridge with ice maker, microwave, breakfast bar with three bar stools, a Keurig and a traditional coffee maker—perfect for quick breakfasts or preparing meals together. The dining table seats 12 comfortably, making it ideal for family dinners, game nights, or long brunches after morning walks along 30A.Step onto the screened porch and into your private backyard retreat. The heated pool with waterfall sets the scene, while the fire pit, summer kitchen, and outdoor dining area provide space for evening cookouts or relaxed nights under the stars. A washer and dryer and a convenient half bath add practical comfort during your stay.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, ensuite bath with soaking tub and walk-in showerBedroom 2: King suite, TV, ensuite bath with soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, and custom makeup vanityBedroom 3: Two queen beds, TV, private bath with walk-in showerBedroom 4: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds, TV, private bath with shower/tub comboTop Amenities- Private pool with waterfall (heating available for an additional fee)- Fire pit for evening gatherings- Outdoor dining area with seating for 8 and a grill- Hanging porch swing- Screened-in porch overlooking the pool- Six-seater & four-seater golf carts and four bicycles for exploring the neighborhood- Outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach- Open-concept living area with plush seating- Kitchen island with bar stools, fridge with ice maker, microwave, and Keurig- Dining table for 12WaterSound Beach CommunityWaterSound Beach is a private, gated community along scenic 30A known for its sugar-white sand beaches and rolling dunes. Guests have access to private beach boardwalks, two community pools (Dunesider Pool and Bridges Pool), and a playground perfect for kids. Walking and biking trails wind throughout the neighborhood, offering a peaceful coastal setting just minutes from local dining and shopping.The LocationSouthern Sol is just minutes from Seagrove Beach dining favorites including Bruno’s Pizza, Cafe Thirty-A, Surfing Deer, The Perfect Pig, The Big Chill 30A, and Old Florida Fish House, plus shopping and restaurants in Seaside and WaterColor.Whether it’s a family vacation, friends’ getaway, or a special celebration, Southern Sol makes it easy to enjoy the coast and everything 30A offers.Your stay at Southern Sol comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Details to Note:* A fee applies for fitness center access.* Sorry no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.An initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
